mode: Built-in image_gen edit tool, one call per overlapping tile
method: Six 640x640 crops per original 1774x887 panorama, including horizontal wrap. AI adds fine detail at 1254x1254. Vision homography registers each tile against the original; CoreImage restores original broad color and lighting. Tiles are blended with smooth overlap into 3548x1774. This is AI-reconstructed detail, not additional original photographic information.
station_transparency: station-window-cutout.png retained byte-for-byte at its original resolution; normalized UV alignment is independent of color texture resolution.
